## Linco 1.0.13

- Conversations repaint from their existing cache when you return to the app window.
- Long conversation redraws keep the last complete screen and scrollbar steady until the updated view is ready, avoiding rapid history scrolling.
- Startup and window resizing preserve usable terminal dimensions, preventing text from wrapping into a single narrow column.
- Output continues entering the conversation buffer while the window is hidden. Reading position is preserved, and clicking, scrolling, or typing returns immediately to the live terminal.

## Linco 1.0.13 更新

- 返回窗口时，从已有缓存重新显示对话。
- 长对话重绘期间保留上一屏完整画面与滚动条，等更新后的视图准备好再切换，避免快速滚屏。
- 启动和缩放时保留可用的终端尺寸，避免文字挤成一列。
- 窗口隐藏期间持续处理智能体输出，保留阅读位置；点击、滚动或输入时立即接回实时终端。

Windows x64, Apple Silicon, and Intel Mac installers are included. Mac builds are ad-hoc signed; first launch may require allowing the app in macOS settings.
